main.description: Lift a community's instance removal, also when its community row has since been deleted, and publish the negation of its !takedown label on the community DID. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete or malformed, including a subject that is not a DID; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The DID is not an indexed community and has no active community removal; do not retry.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is stale or the community has no active removal; refetch getSubjectState before retrying.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: UnsupportedReason
errors.description: The reason is not supported for this action; choose a supported reason before retrying.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

input.description: Request to restore a removed community

subject.description: DID of the community to restore; a DID with no active community removal that is not an indexed community is refused with InvalidSubject

expectedVersion.description: Opaque subject-state version of at://<subject> expected by the caller

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes equivalent restore requests idempotent

reason.description: Public reason classification for restoring the community; the doxing and illegal-content reasons are refused

privateNote.description: Private administrative note retained only on the admin action
